choice.shop.random: Random (ticked slots drawn from the seed)
desc.activatedFlute: Ticked, the Activated Flute is in the item pool as a second Progressive Ocarina. Unticked, the Flute is woken at the weathervane.
desc.allow_collect: Lets a check holding an item for someone else open itself when they collect it.
desc.anyOrder: Any order makes each copy a specific rung, so the top of the ladder can turn up first.
desc.beemizer_total_chance: How often a filler pickup becomes bees instead.
desc.beemizer_trap_chance: How often those bees are the hostile kind.
desc.blue_clock_time: Minutes a blue clock adds or takes away.
desc.bonus: Handed over with the upgrade, never past the new maximum; at 0 only the maximum rises.
desc.bonusBase: On, a share of what the upgrade added; off, of the new maximum.
desc.boss_shuffle: Which boss stands at the end of which dungeon.
desc.bush_shuffle: Shuffles what a pulled bush hides.
desc.capacity_explosives_mode: Vanilla in pool: the upgrades become items to find anywhere, and the pond becomes a check.
desc.capacity_meter_bonus_step: On, a share of what the upgrade added to the bar, which is nothing past the empty tier; off, of the full bar.
desc.capacity_meter_mode: An upgrade lowers what each use costs; the bar never grows. Vanilla in pool: the upgrade becomes an item to find, and its spot a check.
desc.capacity_progressive: On, upgrades climb the ladder in the order found; off, each carries a fixed step and can be found in any order.
desc.capacity_projectiles_mode: Vanilla in pool: the upgrades become items to find anywhere, and the pond becomes a check.
desc.capacity_upgrades_enabled: Off: no capacity changes, and the pond sells its upgrades as usual.
desc.capacity_wallet_jumps: Comma separated steps in hundreds of rupees adding up to the whole climb; read only with the Free sequence curve.
desc.copies: Extra copies are more of the same item; one past the top rung gives rupees instead.
desc.countdown_start_time: Minutes on the clock when a countdown starts.
desc.crystals_needed_for_ganon: Fewer crystals means a shorter ending.
desc.crystals_needed_for_gt: Fewer crystals means a shorter seed.
desc.death_link: Dying sends everyone else in the session to their death too.
desc.dungeon_prize_shuffle: Pendants and crystals move between dungeons.
desc.entrance_shuffle: Where the doorways lead, from dungeon doors alone up to every door in both worlds.
desc.entrance_shuffle_seed: The seed the doorway shuffle is drawn from.
desc.glitch_boots: Starts you with the boots when the glitch setting needs them.
desc.glitches_required: How much trick knowledge the seed may expect before it calls something reachable.
desc.goal: What ends the seed and what it asks of you first.
desc.green_clock_time: Minutes a green clock adds or takes away.
desc.heart_cap: Hearts a lower ceiling takes out of the seed come back as rupee pickups.
desc.hints: Whether telepathic tiles and stones tell you where things are.
desc.include_npc_checks: Rewards from characters, bosses and story events join the shuffle.
desc.include_world_items: Ledge and island items, dig and dash prizes, the tablets, the pedestal and the keys standing on dungeon floors.
desc.item_power_byrna_barrier: The blue barrier makes you invulnerable while it is up.
desc.item_power_hammer_tablets: The hammer can read the tablets in place of a sword.
desc.item_power_powder_fairy: Magic powder can turn an enemy into a fairy.
desc.item_power_silver_arrows_anywhere: Silver arrows do full damage to every enemy, not only the final boss.
desc.jumps: Comma separated steps adding up to the whole climb; read only with the Free sequence curve.
desc.key_drop_shuffle: Adds the keys enemies drop and the keys hidden under pots to the shuffle.
desc.killable_thieves: Lets the thieves that normally shrug off every hit be killed.
desc.misery_mire_medallion: The medallion that opens this dungeon.
desc.open_pyramid: Whether the hole in the pyramid is open before you earn your way in.
desc.placement: Own dungeons: any dungeon. Own world and Any world: anywhere. Different world and Start with roll as Original dungeon.
desc.plando_connections: Hand-written entrance connections, set before the seed rolls.
desc.pondItems: Zero leaves this pond out of the shuffle.
desc.pondShare: All three ponds read the capacity pond rows; their own are kept and come back when you turn this off.
desc.pot_shuffle: Shuffles what is hidden under the pots.
desc.red_clock_time: Minutes a red clock adds or takes away.
desc.restrict_dungeon_item_on_boss: Keeps the map, compass and keys of a dungeon off its own boss.
desc.retro_bow: Arrows are no longer found or carried; every shot costs rupees.
desc.retro_caves: Adds the extra caves and the old-style take-any choices to the world.
desc.retro_silver: Capped so the final fight's {hits} silver shots in a row fit in the biggest wallet.
desc.retro_wood: A shot you cannot afford does not fire.
desc.scams: Whether the merchants who sell you something unseen can lie about what it is.
desc.shopSlotNone: No vanilla stock is recorded for this slot.
desc.shop_item_slots: How many of the ticked slots hold a shuffled item; read by Sequential and Random only.
desc.shop_price_arrows: Off while retro bow is on.
desc.shop_price_bottle: The shelf takes what is in the bottle and hands the empty bottle back.
desc.shop_price_hearts: Paying costs health on the spot; the range stops one heart under the heart ceiling on the Items tab.
desc.shop_price_hearts_max: Stops one heart under the heart ceiling on the Items tab.
desc.shop_price_modifier: Scales every rolled price by this percentage; a price still never passes what you can hold.
desc.shop_slot_depth: Above one, a slot restocks with another shuffled item after each purchase.
desc.shuffle_prizes: Shuffles the drops enemies leave and what falls from a bonked tree.
desc.small_key_shuffle: Own dungeons: any dungeon. Own world and Any world: anywhere. Different world, Start with and Universal roll as Original dungeon.
desc.start_inventory_from_pool: Items you begin with are taken out of the pool instead of added to it.
desc.tier: Unticked, this rung leaves the ladder and the rungs above it move down one.
desc.tile_shuffle: Shuffles the rooms whose floor tiles fly at you.
desc.timer: Playing against a clock, counting up or down, or a race a single hit ends.
desc.triforce_pieces_available: How many pieces exist in the seed.
desc.triforce_pieces_extra: Pieces placed beyond the number you must collect.
desc.triforce_pieces_mode: How the number of pieces to collect is decided.
desc.triforce_pieces_percentage: Pieces placed, as a percentage of the number you must collect.
desc.triforce_pieces_required: How many pieces you must collect to finish.
desc.turtle_rock_medallion: The medallion that opens this dungeon.
detail.accessibility.items: every item can be collected; some locations may stay shut.
detail.accessibility.minimal: only what finishing needs is guaranteed.
detail.darkRoom.off: dark rooms count as passable without one.
detail.darkRoom.on: a dark room counts as passable only with a ticked light.
detail.mode.inverted: the two worlds swap: you begin in the dark one.
detail.mode.open: you start free, with the castle already behind you.
detail.mode.standard: the seed opens with the rescue.
detail.pond.capacityVanillaCost: the same throws and prices, but the first few hand over a shuffled item.
detail.pond.custom: your own price ladder; the first few throws hand over a shuffled item.
detail.pond.wishVanillaCost: the two grants shuffled, handed over for nothing, as the game gives them.
